title: Add bounded paper lifecycle cursors and reject non-executable fleet children
code_disposition: Keep dynamic fleet as sole owner; classify static runtime and smoke strategy as explicit compatibility/test paths.
Enforced validate_executable_binding in paper_fleet_reconciler to reject bindings with missing required fields (binding_id, runtime_id, artifact_id, artifact_version, capital_pool_id, plan_id).
Verified bounded lifecycle outbox cursor compaction (LifecycleTelemetryOutbox.ack_cursor) in paper_runtime.py.
